findings.reason: DR021, DR022 and DR023 remain UNRESOLVED for this item. A113 and rows 117–122 provide static PMB conditions, matched isolate MICs and time-kill summaries, but no measured free concentration-time profiles, free AUC, measured free peak, binding assessment or source-supported mapping to animal PK. Dosing-frequency or interval variation separating the indices is not documented. The projected fCmax descriptor does not establish these inputs.
findings.needed_material: Downstream coverage review must identify authorized exposure inputs and mappings, define common exposure windows and the fT>MIC duration-versus-percentage convention, and assess whether the design separates the indices. Keep ranking unresolved without supporting evidence.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE inputs include three identified isolates, row-linked PMB MICs, two static conditions, change from 0 h, response times, mean ± SD and duplicate experiments. MIC method, medium, testing standard, MIC replicate and summary definitions, untreated growth-control observations and isolate-specific starting inocula are NOT_FOUND in this page. The overall starting-inoculum summary cannot supply isolate-specific baselines.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported MIC testing context, medium and growth controls, plus any isolate-specific baseline records required for the intended analysis; retain unspecified fields as unresolved until reviewed.

findings.reason: A113 reports static concentrations chosen as hollow-fibre projected fCmax, but does not state a measured total or unbound concentration basis, medium or conversion inputs. These static conditions cannot be relabeled as measured unbound animal or human exposure.
findings.needed_material: Record the concentration basis as NOT_FOUND and obtain independent compatibility review before any free-exposure conversion or physiological bridge.

findings.reason: MI013 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at index: PK/PD exposure-target estimability. Target estimation has not been performed in the supplied proposal. This page supplies response summaries and matched MICs, but no supported exposure targets or estimability decision. DR026, DR027 and DR028 remain separate; a planned T05 estimate is not a missing measured value.
findings.needed_material: At index, assess which exposure targets are estimable under SC033 and report when no supported target can be determined. Preserve separate stasis, 1-log kill and 2-log kill definitions, comparators, endpoint windows and uncertainty. PD qualification and subsequent target-attainment simulation depend on this determination.

findings.reason: D117–D122 and E117–E122 contain MERO and RIF MICs despite the PMB-only test-drug scope. A114 states combination arms are omitted. These susceptibility values are source context, not authorization to analyze other test drugs or substitute their MICs for PMB MICs. RIF entries >64 must remain as written.
findings.needed_material: Independent review should route MERO and RIF MIC columns as contextual susceptibility evidence and preserve the PMB-only analysis boundary.

findings.reason: A113 explicitly says static concentrations were chosen as hollow-fibre projected fCmax. The observed static time-kill summaries and this model-derived design rationale have different evidence status; the note does not establish benchmark-file membership or permission to use projected results for primary initialization or ranking.
findings.needed_material: Independent review should preserve the reported design rationale, distinguish it from observed responses, and enforce R11 before any primary-analysis use of published model-derived results.

findings.reason: A115 states that hollow-fibre CFU time courses in Figure 1 are figure-only and not digitized. Only the supplied text and static table cells were available for this assessment; hollow-fibre time-course measurements cannot be reconstructed from them.
findings.needed_material: Retain the static table as SOURCE_VALUES. Any later need for hollow-fibre time courses requires separately authorized source provision or digitization with its own provenance.
